title: Vacation Rental Cleaning Checklist Printable, Short Term Rental Turnover Checklist, Host Cleaner Guide, Damage Report, Cleaning Log PDF
description:
Get consistent, five-star cleans after every guest. This room-by-room turnover checklist tells your cleaner exactly what to do, so nothing gets missed and your guests always walk into a spotless home.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (8 pages, 95+ tasks)
- Cover with how-to and cleaning tips
- Arrival, laundry, entry & outdoor
- Kitchen
- Bathrooms
- Bedrooms & living room
- Final walk-through + supplies running low
- Damage & maintenance report + guest left-behind items
- Monthly cleaning log

Every page has fields for property, date, cleaner and next check-in, plus space for notes.

YOU WILL RECEIVE
- PDF in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in)
- PDF in A4

HOW TO USE
Print one set for every turnover, keep a stack in your cleaning closet, or open the PDF on a tablet. Ask your cleaner to send a photo of the completed pages.

PERFECT FOR
Short term and vacation rental hosts, co-hosts, property managers and cleaning teams.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a DIGITAL product. No physical item will be shipped.
- For use in your own rental properties. Please do not resell or share the files.
- Designed with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and finalized by me.

Need a custom version for your property? Send me a message, I usually reply within 24 hours.
